title: Profile
subtitle: Your account, language and time zone.
languageHelp: The language of the whole interface.
timezoneHelp: Every time is shown in this zone. Data is stored in UTC.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
passwordRules: At least 15 characters (12 with two-step verification), no spaces at the start or the end; do not use your e-mail, your name or “predigol”.

securityPanel.mfaHelp: Besides the password, signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app.

identity.title: Confirm it is you
identity.body: To end other sessions, type your password or a code from your authenticator app.
identity.useCode: Use a code from the app

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.help: Which e-mails we send you. Those about your account, its security, your requests about your data and changes to the legal texts always arrive.

categoryHelp.account: Invitation, activation and changes to your account.
categoryHelp.security: Recovering your password and sign-in notices.
categoryHelp.membership: Reminders before it expires and payment confirmations.
categoryHelp.support: Answers to your questions and reports.
categoryHelp.privacy: The receipt and the answer of your requests about your data.
categoryHelp.legal: Changes to the terms or the privacy policy you must accept.

status.bounced: Your e-mail bounces: we cannot deliver messages to you. Check that your account's address is right and write to us if it changed.
status.complained: You marked one of our e-mails as spam: we only send you what is essential about your account, its security, your data and the legal texts.

sessionIdle: It closes sooner if you go {idle} without using it; every use renews it.

membership.title: Membership

line.grace: Your membership has ended: until {date} you keep full access.
line.expired: Your membership has ended. Your data stays here; renewing brings everything back.
line.suspended: Your account is suspended: write to us.
line.none: Your account has no membership period yet.

membership.willNotRenew: You told us you will not renew. If you change your mind, write to us.
membership.notEnforced: For now, access stays full even when the membership ends.
membership.renewHelp: You pay by the agreed means and we record it at once: the membership carries on from its end date, or from today if it has ended.
membership.renewNone: To renew, answer any of our e-mails or ask whoever invited you.
membership.whatsappText: Hello, I would like to renew my PrediGol membership.

banner.grace: Your membership has ended: until {date} you keep full access.
banner.expired: Limited access: your membership has ended. Renewing brings everything back.
banner.suspended: Your account is suspended: write to us.

limited.expiredBody: Your data stays here. You can see your profile, your saved picks, the help and the legal texts, and download your data. Renewing brings everything back.
limited.suspendedBody: You can see your profile, your saved picks, the help and the legal texts, and download your data. Write to us to know more.
limited.readOnly: Read-only while the membership has ended.
